what: Organize PDF shows every page of your PDF as a small picture, so you can see the whole document at once and put it in order. Drag pages to a new place, turn sideways pages the right way, delete pages you do not need and insert blank pages.

You can add several PDFs at once and mix their pages freely, which makes it a quick way to build one tidy document from scans, forms and reports. When you save, each page is copied with its original text, images and links, so nothing is lost or blurred.
Everything happens in your browser. Your PDFs are never uploaded.
uses: Fix the page order of a scan
Put pages that went through the scanner in the wrong order back where they belong.
Rotate only the landscape pages, such as a wide table, so they read the right way.
Remove pages you do not need
Delete blank pages, duplicates or pages with private details before you share a file.
Add a contract, a signed form and an invoice, then arrange their pages into a single PDF.
Insert a blank page between sections for handwritten notes or as a divider when printing.
tutorial: Click "Click or drop PDF files here" or drag one or more PDFs onto the box. A thumbnail appears for each page, numbered in its current order. With more than one file, each page also shows which file and page it came from, such as "report p. 3".

With a mouse, press on a page and drag it. A blue bar shows where it will land. On a phone or tablet, hold the ⠿ handle in the top corner of a page and drag. You can also use the ← and → buttons under each page to move it one place at a time.
Press ⟳ under a page to turn it a quarter turn clockwise. To turn several at once, tick their boxes and use "Rotate left" or "Rotate right" at the top.
Press ✕ under a page, or tick several pages and press "Delete". If you remove the wrong page, press "Undo".
Tick the page that the blank page should follow and press "+ Blank page". With nothing ticked, the blank page goes at the end. It gets the same size as the page before it.
Click a page (or its tick box) to select it. "Select all" ticks every page, which is handy for rotating a whole file. If several pages are ticked and you drag one of them, they all move together.
Click "Save PDF". A message such as "Saved 12 pages" appears with the file size. Click "Download PDF" to get the file, named like report-organized.pdf.
features: See every page as a picture. Large PDFs load quickly because pages are drawn only as you scroll to them.
Drag and drop that works on touch screens
Reorder with a mouse, a finger or a pen, with arrow buttons and keyboard moves as an alternative.
Rotate, delete and insert blank pages
Fix single pages or many at once using the tick boxes.
Pages from different files can be mixed in any order.
Step back through every change with the Undo button or Ctrl+Z.
Pages are copied, not re-drawn, so text stays sharp and selectable and links keep working.
The file never leaves your device.

example.title: Worked example: a scanned contract in the wrong order
example.text: Jonas scanned a 6-page contract but the pages came out as 1, 2, 5, 3, 4, 6, and page 6 is upside down. He adds contract.pdf, drags the page labelled 5 to just after page 4, then presses ⟳ twice under the last page to turn it 180 degrees. He also adds signature.pdf, whose one page appears at the end. He clicks "Save PDF", sees "Saved 7 pages", and downloads contract-organized.pdf with every page in order and upright.

tips: Keyboard users: focus a page and press Alt + ← or Alt + → to move it, Space to select it and Delete to remove it.
To reverse a whole section, tick the pages and drag them as one group to their new place, then fine-tune with the arrow buttons.
Rotation is saved as the page direction, so it does not change the file size or the quality.
You can place the same page twice: add the same PDF again and keep the copy you need.
For a very long PDF, scroll slowly and pages are drawn as they come into view. Dragging a page near the top or bottom of the window scrolls the page for you.
problems: A message says the file "is password protected"
Open it in a PDF reader that knows the password, save a copy without a password, and add that copy.
A message says the file "could not be read as a PDF"
The file may be damaged or not really a PDF. Try opening it in another PDF reader and saving it again.
Dragging on my phone scrolls the page instead
Drag using the ⠿ handle in the top corner of a page, or use the ← and → buttons.
Pages are drawn as you scroll to them. Wait a moment or scroll a little; the saved PDF always contains the full pages.
The Save PDF button is greyed out
All pages have been deleted, or a file is still opening. Press Undo or add a PDF.
